description: Human decision: when deleting a connector with bound PersonChannel identities, archive rather than delete. Preserve connector ID/history references and identity scope; hide archived configs from runtime and ordinary BO configuration lists, keep read-only historical lookup by ID. Add migration/schema and explicit idempotent archive lifecycle, ensure ingress teardown and database state consistent, allow later fresh connector of same provider. Audit ChannelConfig queries, BO delete action, supervisor boot, subscriptions. Tests first for archive safety, rollback/error paths, runtime non-selection, history/identity retention; mix q and focused tests. Read docs/services/channels.md, system-config.md, DESIGN.md, bo-components.md; no commit/push.

comments.text: Human selected archive instead of delete when connector has scoped identities. Added 00006 archived_at, 00007 DB CHECK archived implies disabled, ChannelConfig.archive idempotent operation, Channels.Api archive event, BO archive+runtime sync after ingress teardown, historical lookup by id and exclusion from provider-only lookup/BO list. Scoped identity FK 00003/00005 prevents destructive nullification. BO regression verifies preserved PersonChannel and denied forged reactivation. Focused 203 tests/2 properties and mix q pass. Still in progress: audit every runtime/BO path for archived queries and external teardown failure recovery; no commit/push.

Archive follow-up: scoped identity FK rejects hard delete; archived configs excluded from runtime/provider lookup and new ingress identity resolution while historical PersonChannel lookup by connector id remains. BO archive event through Channels NodeRouter syncs runtime after archiving; DB check prevents archived enabled state even via raw changeset. BO + connector + identity focused tests pass, mix q was clean before latest SMTP/metadata tests; final gate still pending.

Human decision: archive of data-source connector must attempt provider unwatch of every active subscription before disabling/archive; if any teardown fails, leave connector live, report failed watches for retry. Already-successful unwatches must be recorded stopped so later retries are idempotent; do not claim atomic rollback of external provider effects.

Archive now covers actual BO data-source ProviderLive route (not ChannelsLive): Engine DataSources.stop_config_watch_channels unwatchs active/error watches, persists successful stops for idempotent retry, returns failed watch IDs; BO blocks archive on any failure and reports them. ProviderLive archive uses Channels event, hides archived configs and denies reactivation. Existing data-source delete test updated to assert archive; failure regression added. Engine watch scope by config and explicit callback URL in zaq-emb.21. Data-source/BO/ingestion suite 435 tests/1 property passes after source-key permission regression fix; mix q passes. Still review provider-side race/remaining runtime audit before selective commit.

Actual ProviderLive data-source delete now scopes target by current provider/kind/unarchived instead of accepting arbitrary IDs; regression covers cross-provider attempted archive. Failure path remains archive-blocking. Combined API/resolver/ProviderLive suite 171 tests passes, mix q passes. Still review watch-creation/renewal race during teardown and runtime sync recovery before closing bead or selective commit.
